sinopsis.es: En la víspera de Navidad, Dejair, un ex luchador de la resistencia contra la dictadura militar, se reúne con su familia en el patio trasero. Un regalo de pistola de agua lleva a Dejair a denunciar lo absurdo de darle un arma a un niño.
sinopsis.en: On Christmas Eve, Dejair, a former resistance fighter against the military dictatorship, gathers with his family in the backyard. During a Secret Santa game, the contrast between appearances and private truths emerges. A water gun gift leads Dejair to denounce the absurdity of giving a child a weapon.
